guides.favoredWhen: She trades unless empowered Q is up and shrouds your waste. Respect stacks, punish W-down.

keyTips.text: She only trades unless your empowered Q is up: red bar is your license.
She shrouds to make you waste empowered Q: hold it for the visible.
She trades and all-ins hard while your W is down: pool-down is danger.

tips.text: Stay behind minions against her E: the wave blocks the mark.
Poke Q windows: unempowered trades are hers.
Pool her all-in when W returns: the dodge turns the dive.
Track shroud cooldown: no shroud means free Qs.
Q banked plus pool held: the Akali who never reaches you never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Skill matchup. Pool her Charm on read, trade on your Q windows, and never fight inside her wave.

keyTips.text: Pool her Charm on read or on reaction (about {cd:8:W}): the dodge is the lane.
Trade on your Q windows (about {cd:8:Q}): empowered Qs decide exchanges.
Fight outside her wave: inside it her trades win.

tips.text: She takes early trade windows on your Q and pool cooldowns: vary both.
She plays the map before you scale: match priority, do not bleed plates.
Match her post-6 shoves: lost priority is lost map.
Never commit blind into a held Charm: force it with Q feints first.
Pool timed plus Q windows banked: the Ahri who never lands Charm never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: Weak early with long cooldowns. Survive to 6 and first back, then turn with pool.

keyTips.text: Weak early with long cooldowns and mediocre sustain: survive the first five levels.
After 6 and first back you get strong: the spike flips it.
She punishes your Q-down, especially after empowered Q: vary the windows.

tips.text: Concede the push: her waveclear beats yours, so farm under tower.
Build toward first back: the item is the lane.
Pool her R: the dodge blanks her ult.
After 6, all-in with pool ready: W-down wins.
Spike hit plus pool held: the Syndra who never stuns you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: He is favoured early. Survive on pool timing, and all-in only his oversteps.

keyTips.text: He is favoured early: range and all-ins beat your sustain.
Do not stand for his Q follow-up auto: walk off after it lands.
All-in his oversteps with pool ready: no shadows means no escape.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Concede early farm for HP: your scaling outlasts his lane.
Track his jungler: his team plays around his R.
Pool his R: the dodge turns his ult.
Save pool for his R, not his poke: W the ult, eat the Qs.
Death Mark lands him behind you: pool toward the exit when he ults.
Early survived plus pool held: the Zed who never snowballs never outscales you.

keyTips.text: Farm safely through the weak early levels and limit trades until level five or six, then play more aggressively once the transition arrives instead of staying passive by default.
Trade around empowered Transfusion: landing the empowered Q on a champion also heals Vladimir, and Ghost can be worth spending to secure one for a health lead when the exchange favors it.
Open committed lane fights with Hemoplague so marked targets take amplified damage and heal Vladimir for the damage dealt.

tips.text: Hold a pushing opponent's wave closer to your tower so their jungler has less room to approach, and never let it settle on the opponent's side.
Keep collecting side-lane farm and pressuring side-turret plates without abandoning farming for low-value grouping.
Join the team's plans more as the game moves on: when the team prepares for Baron, push the top side lane so Vladimir stays close enough to rotate.
Protect the farm and experience that build Vladimir's late-game strength, choosing side-lane pressure that supports the next objective.
In late fights, threaten the enemy back line and deal with squishier targets before spending time on tanks.
Never walk unwarded jungle routes alone: getting caught by layered crowd control can end the fight and the game.
Cast Hemoplague before the rest of a committed damage sequence so allies also benefit from its damage amplification.

itemization.text: Build Hextech Rocketbelt, Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Rabadon's Deathcap, Riftmaker, Void Staff, and Zhonya's Hourglass as the standard line, keeping Riftmaker and Void Staff into tankier teams.

Take the high-burst alternative of Stormsurge with Sorcerer's Shoes, Rocketbelt, Void Staff, Deathcap, and Zhonya's; run Stormraider's Surge with Nimbus Cloak, Transcendence, Gathering Storm, Legend: Haste, and Cut Down, with Deathfire Touch plus Ignite as the aggressive melee-lane option.
Swap boots by game: Sorcerer's Shoes for damage into squishy teams, Swifties against repeated slows, Lucidity for haste, and Mercury's Treads reserved for substantial magic damage and crowd control.
